Culture

Why Minute

  • Work That Matters

    You'll build products used by millions of sports fans around the world. Your work makes an impact.

  • Global Team

    Collaborate with talented teammates across Tel Aviv, New York, London and beyond.

  • Grow With Us

    A culture of ownership and continuous growth. Your best work is always ahead of you.

Our values

What we believe.

  • Make an Impact

    We aim to leverage the stories we tell, the products we build and the actions we take to impact the greater good of our organization, partners, audiences and the communities that sports brings together.

  • Grow Through Trust & Accountability

    We empower each other through trust, ownership and accountability. United by a shared purpose, we make confident decisions, stay flexible and hold ourselves to high standards.

  • Be What's Next

    Our expertise and ambition drives us to challenge the status quo, push boundaries and continuously evolve. We embrace change, pursue new possibilities and lead the way in shaping what's next.

  • Embrace Diversity & Inclusion

    We continuously evolve and foster a culture that values diversity, belonging and authenticity. We lead with curiosity, value different perspectives and encourage every voice across our teams and the communities we serve in sports and beyond.

  • Enjoy the Journey

    We bring the passion and spirit of sports into how we work. We celebrate our wins, build meaningful friendships and make the most of our journey together.
